verdict.rationale: GitHub docs confirm a 'public code matching' feature that flags Copilot suggestions matching public GitHub code (docs-11), which is the core capability an engineering lead would need for review-safety, but there is no evidence of a dedicated license-reference report/dashboard an engineering lead can inspect, and community threads show ongoing concern about verbatim/GPL code leakage and licensing risk that the feature only partially mitigates. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how license info is surfaced/reported to engineering leads, admin-facing audit views for public-code matches, and independent confirmation the matching filter reliably catches licensed code beyond GitHub's own 0.1% verbatim-rate claim.
